title: 深"V"，涨停潮！半导体大爆发，多只ETF大涨10%！
summary: A股7月21日全天呈深V形态，科创50指数收涨10.73%，创2026年最大单日涨幅；科创半导体ETF大涨逾19%，集成电路ETF、芯片ETF涨停；华虹宏力涨超17%。上证综指涨1.79%，创业板指涨7.05%。
why: A股半导体全线爆发是重大市场事件，若持有半导体相关个股或期权，隐含波动率大涨，sell put方向需警惕短期回调。

title: ETF收评：科创50暴力反弹涨超10%，AI硬件反攻，科创半导体ETF涨超19%，集成电路ETF、芯片ETF涨停
summary: 科创板、创业板强势反弹，多只半导体ETF创历史大涨纪录，AI硬件板块全线上扬。科创半导体ETF单日净值涨幅超19%，上半年该类ETF已累计涨逾177%。
why: 科创半导体ETF单日大涨19%，短期波动率骤升，持有相关正股或期权需关注次日波动率压缩风险。

title: 港股收评：恒指跌0.04% 科指涨1.32% 黄金股普涨 半导体、PCB板块大涨 智谱涨超36%
summary: 港股7月21日三指分化：恒生指数收跌0.04%报25132，恒生科技指数涨1.32%；华虹宏力涨超17%，建滔积层板涨超12%，紫金黄金国际涨超10%，智谱AI涨超36%。
why: 港股科技指数逆势上扬，华虹宏力创单日大涨，半导体主题继续受资金青睐，对相关港股期权隐含波动率有拉升作用。

title: Stock futures climb ahead of corporate earnings, Nasdaq rebounds: Live updates
summary: US stock futures rose Tuesday as investors braced for a flurry of earnings reports amid signs of revival in chip stocks. Nasdaq-100 contracts jumped 1.3%, with semiconductor names taking center stage ahead of Big Tech results (Tesla and Alphabet both report July 22).
why: 纳斯达克期货大涨1.3%，半导体领涨，科技财报季高峰来临，持有相关美股期权需注意财报前后波动率变化。

title: Oil prices dip as mediation efforts offset U.S.-Iran strikes
summary: Oil softened Tuesday with Brent near $90/bbl as mediators pushed for a 10-day U.S.-Iran ceasefire, even as attacks entered a 10th consecutive day. A Houthi naval blockade threat on Saudi Arabia capped any sustained pullback.
why: 油价高位震荡叠加停火预期，影响通胀预期和美联储加息路径，是对冲持仓和期权策略的重要宏观背景。

title: China's Politburo July meeting seen accelerating fiscal delivery, not new stimulus
summary: Analysts expect the late-July Politburo meeting to call for faster implementation of existing infrastructure projects and possible front-loading of Q4 bond quotas. Roughly RMB 6.8 trillion of approved government bonds remain unissued; Beijing is unlikely to announce major new packages.
why: 政治局信号若偏积极财政，将提振A股和港股消费科技板块情绪，对国内消费相关标的期权是潜在正面催化。

title: Tesla rides robotaxi momentum into earnings season (Q2 results July 22)
summary: Tesla reports Q2 2026 earnings after market close July 22. Q2 deliveries hit 480,126 vehicles (+25% YoY), its strongest quarter since Q3 2025. Robotaxi now operates in 5 cities; Texas fleet scaled to 175 vehicles. 2026 capex guidance raised to $25B from $20B.
why: 特斯拉明日财报是市场催化剂，Robotaxi进展和毛利率是关键看点，财报前后隐含波动率将大幅变动，持有TSLA期权者需特别关注。

title: Alphabet (GOOGL) Week Review: EU Hit, Gemini Delays, Earnings Wednesday
summary: Alphabet reports Q2 2026 earnings July 22. Shares at $346.77 amid a $4.67B EU antitrust fine (Android/DMA) and Gemini 3.5 Pro delays. Q2 consensus: revenue $116.9B, EPS $2.90. Google Cloud accelerated to $20B/quarter (+63% YoY) in Q1.
why: 谷歌财报与特斯拉同日发布，将定调本周科技板块情绪；EU罚款与Gemini延迟是重大下行风险，期权隐含波动率已升高，财报后需关注IV崩塌。

title: Apple Intelligence approved for launch in China with Alibaba's Qwen AI
summary: China's CAC approved Apple Intelligence on July 15, with Alibaba Qwen handling ~65% of multimodal tasks and Baidu managing ~35% for Siri voice/search. The process took 22 months. No launch date announced yet; regulatory green light is now in place.
why: 通义千问成为Apple Intelligence在华核心AI供应商，实质性提升阿里云商业化空间，对阿里巴巴估值有正面催化；也可能推动iPhone在华销量反弹。

title: Alibaba Stock Surges As Apple AI Deal Fuels New Rally
summary: BABA surged on July 20 driven by four catalysts: Apple Intelligence approval, DOJ $600M non-prosecution deal ($325M penalty), Morgan Stanley Overweight with triple-digit AI cloud growth, and stock approaching key technical levels. Stock up ~4.6% on the day.
why: DOJ和解移除重大法律尾险，苹果AI合作打开增量营收，配合摩根士丹利维持增持，阿里估值修复逻辑清晰，对sell put策略支撑明显。

title: China's Xiaomi unveils SUV series dubbed Sky Nomad (new EREV brand)
summary: Xiaomi officially confirmed Sky Nomad (Pengcheng/澎城) on July 8 — a standalone EREV SUV brand competing with Li Auto and AITO. First model Kunlun N3 is a 5.3m+, 7-seat full-size EREV with 70kWh+ battery, priced RMB 200k-450k. Xiaomi shares surged 10% intraday on announcement.
why: 小米推出独立增程品牌澎城，直接挑战理想汽车和AITO，扩大EV赛道布局；当日股价涨10%说明市场正面解读，对小米sell put有支撑。

title: Micron Says Memory Chip Supply Will Remain Tight Beyond 2027
summary: Micron disclosed it is sold out of HBM capacity for both 2026 and 2027, and expects broad memory market tightness to extend beyond 2027. The company recently signed 16 multiyear customer contracts—unprecedented in the memory industry—as AI compute demand drives structurally higher ASPs.
why: 美光HBM供应售罄至2027年以后，多年合同锁定高价，是极强的长线看涨信号；对持有MU正股和sell put策略均利好，关注内存赛道持续涨价逻辑。

title: China Renaissance Moves Trip.com (TCOM) to Hold on Antitrust Overhang
summary: China Renaissance downgraded Trip.com (TCOM/9961.HK) to Hold with a $42 target on July 2, citing unresolved antitrust investigation. BofA also cut its target from $78 to $64 (maintained Buy), noting a 'modest' Q1 beat but weak Q2 outlook and antitrust uncertainty.
why: 携程反垄断调查悬而未决是重大不确定性，多家机构下调目标价，对sell put策略的保护垫变薄，需重新评估行权价选择。
